On August 9, 2024, the Board of Directors (the "Board") of Brown & Brown, Inc., a Florida corporation (the "Company"), appointed Stephen P. Hearn, age 58, to serve as a director of the Company, effective immediately.
Since August 2023, Hearn has served as the chairman of Placing Platform Limited (PPL), a market-owned eTrading platform, and as a non-executive director of Atrium Underwriters Ltd. since June 2024.
Mr. Hearn's initial term as a director on the Board expires at the Company's 2025 Annual Meeting of Shareholders.
